OFFLINE BY DEFAULT

How offline & live mode work

Your core itinerary library works fully offline — no Wi‑Fi or mobile data used. Real people ask a human concierge for up-to-the-minute info; enable Live below to get the same from the web, only when you actually need it.

Live means current information only.Browsing, saving and planning stay inside this app. Hotel, flight and booking searches open an external source only after you choose a live action.

Opening & visitor details

No search results page — this opens the destination's own official tourism site, where hours, closures and tickets are kept current.

Now & soon

Current exhibitions & events

We refresh your smart brief in-app and open the official visitor site for the live events calendar — real listings, not a guess.

If plans change

Transport & routing

Opens the official national or city transport authority, direct — the same source a local concierge would check.

Every fact above comes from a named live source — weather via Open-Meteo, exchange rates via the ECB (Frankfurter), sunrise/sunset, official public holiday calendars and a short Wikipedia brief. If a source can't be reached, we say so — never a guess.

A few essentials

"Export trip" saves just this journey. "Back up everything" saves all your saved trips, journeys, Atelier picks, and saved places to one file — worth doing before you clear your browser data or switch phones.

This page is built to hand off, not to book. Print it, or export it, and take it to your own travel agent, the airline or hotel directly, or your usual booking site — nothing here processes a payment or contacts anyone on your behalf.

Ready for the next one?
Private travel companion · for the solo evenings

Some company,
when you want it.

Travelling alone doesn't mean deciding alone. Talk through the evening — stay out a little longer, head back, or go toward something happening nearby — with someone who takes travel as seriously as you do.

ALWAYS OFFLINE · NO SIGNAL NEEDED

Optional and local-first. Companion can use your journey context to offer an occasional, useful note — no constant chatter, no separate trip system. It replies from a small, fixed set of grounded prompts, not open conversation — think of it as a few honest nudges, not a chat partner.

Classic is the default — warm, clear and comfortable for anyone. Same trustworthy replies in every style; only the wording changes. Worries, tiredness and safety always get a calm, careful voice — even in Playful. No gender either way.

Replies are pre-written responses to common travel moments — not AI, not a human agent, and not tailored conversation.

A small note for this journeyYour companion is quiet until you need it.Optional · offline-ready
Your companionReady when you are

Tell me where you are, or just pick a mood above — I'm here to think out loud with you, not hand you a checklist.

🧪 Test mode — companion QA

Fires one intent at a time (or all of them) in the currently selected persona, so you can check wording without typing each prompt by hand. Uses the same pre-written replies as normal — nothing extra is generated, and it doesn't affect what other people see.

Global Travel lets you design and save trip plans, but it does not book anything for real — no airline, hotel, or payment is ever contacted.
